content: For the time-dependent mirror potential R_{a_t}(x) with a_{t,i}=2u_{0,i}v_{0,i} exp(-2∫_0^t α_s ds), the schedule of α_t controls the scale a_t; since the global minimum of R_{a_t} is located at exp(-2∫_0^t α_s ds) ⊙ m_0 ⊙ w_0 and R_a(x) ∼ log(1/a) ||x||_{L_1} as a → 0, the α_t schedule controls the positional and asymptotic-strength aspects of the implicit bias.
